stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

def transform(grid):
    """Fill inward from a rectangular 5-frame with the repeating 2,5,0,5 layers."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    rs = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if 5 in row]
    cs = [c for row in grid for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 5]
    top, bottom = min(rs), max(rs)
    left, right = min(cs), max(cs)
    colors = (2, 5, 0, 5)
    layer = 1
    while top + layer <= bottom - layer and left + layer <= right - layer:
        r0, r1 = top + layer, bottom - layer
        c0, c1 = left + layer, right - layer
        color = colors[(layer - 1) % len(colors)]
        for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
            out[r0][c] = color
            out[r1][c] = color
        for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
            out[r][c0] = color
            out[r][c1] = color
        layer += 1
    return out
PY
